summary.text: Robert Hower is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a research engineer at the University of Michigan and owner of Numed Technologies.

paragraphs.text: Hower graduated from Milan High School and earned a Ph.D. from the University of Michigan in 2005.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a fourth-generation Michigander, a research engineer at the University of Michigan, a faculty union member, and owner of Numed Technologies, and that he teaches graduate-level classes at Wayne State University.

Hower's survey listed three priorities: increasing funding for public schools from preschool through college, making health care more affordable through greater transparency in medical billing, and keeping costs down by championing a living wage.
He also said he opposes data centers because of pollution, few permanent jobs and increased utility costs for consumers.

sources.title: Robert Hower - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
